description: This Java source file contains integration tests for loan refund transactions in the Apache Fineract platform. It includes test cases for different types of refunds such as merchant issued refund and payout refund, along with their interest refund handling and reversal scenarios.

classes.name: LoanRefundTransactionTest
classes.description: Integration test class for testing various loan refund transaction scenarios in Fineract.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes RestAssured specifications and helper classes before all tests.

methods.name: testMerchantIssuedRefundCreatesAndReversesInterestRefund
methods.description: Tests the creation and reversal of merchant issued refund and associated interest refund.

methods.name: testPayoutRefundCreatesAndReversesInterestRefund
methods.description: Tests the creation and reversal of payout refund and associated interest refund.

methods.name: testMerchantIssuedRefundDoesNotCreateInterestRefundWithLessThanOrEqualToZeroInterest
methods.description: Verifies that interest refunds are not created when interest is less than or equal to zero for merchant refunds.

methods.name: createAndDisburseLoanForMerchantIssuedRefundWithInterestRefund
methods.description: Helper method to create and disburse a loan suitable for merchant refund tests with interest refund.

methods.name: createAndDisburseLoanForPayoutRefundWithInterestRefund
methods.description: Helper method to create and disburse a loan suitable for payout refund tests with interest refund.

methods.name: createLoanForRefundWithInterestRefund
methods.description: Helper method to create a loan with specific refund type and interest, returning the loan ID.
